### Get a list of the samples 
```{r}
names(processed_matrix)
```

```{r}

run_doubletfinder <- function(
    seu,
    PCs = 1:10,
    pN = 0.25,
    pK = 0.09,
    doublet_rate = 0.075,
    sct = FALSE,
    annotations = NULL
) {

  library(Seurat)
  library(DoubletFinder)

  ## 1. pK identification --------------------------------------------

  sweep.res.list <- paramSweep(
    seu,
    PCs = PCs,
    sct = sct
  )

  sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(
    sweep.res.list,
    GT = FALSE
  )

  bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

  ## 2. Homotypic doublet proportion ---------------------------------

  if (is.null(annotations)) {
    annotations <- seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters
  }

  homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)

  ## 3. Expected doublets --------------------------------------------

  nExp_poi <- round(
    doublet_rate * nrow(seu@meta.data)
  )

  nExp_poi.adj <- round(
    nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop)
  )

  ## 4. First DoubletFinder run (unadjusted) -------------------------

  seu <- doubletFinder(
    seu,
    PCs = PCs,
    pN = pN,
    pK = pK,
    nExp = nExp_poi,
    reuse.pANN = NULL,
    sct = sct
  )

  ## Identify the generated pANN column dynamically

  pann_col <- grep(
    "^pANN_",
    colnames(seu@meta.data),
    value = TRUE
  )

  pann_col <- pann_col[length(pann_col)]

  ## 5. Second DoubletFinder run (homotypic adjusted) ----------------

  seu <- doubletFinder(
    seu,
    PCs = PCs,
    pN = pN,
    pK = pK,
    nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
    reuse.pANN = pann_col,
    sct = sct
  )

  ## 6. Return results ------------------------------------------------

  return(list(
    seurat_object = seu,
    sweep_stats = sweep.stats,
    bcmvn = bcmvn,
    homotypic_prop = homotypic.prop,
    nExp_poi = nExp_poi,
    nExp_poi_adj = nExp_poi.adj,
    pANN_column = pann_col
  ))
}

```


#### predict homotypic doublets 
```{r}
HC20 <- readRDS("/Users/brendakarumbo/Desktop/PhD/Project/IM_samples/processed_samples_with_labels/hc20_processed_with_labels.rds")

```


```{r}
result_hc20 <- run_doubletfinder(
  seu = HC20,
  PCs = 1:20,
  pN = 0.25,
  pK = 0.09,
  doublet_rate = 0.031,
  sct = FALSE,
  annotations = HC20@meta.data$seurat_clusters
)
```



```{r}
####Extract the results
HC20 <- result_hc20$seurat_object

result_hc20$bcmvn

result_hc20$homotypic_prop

result_hc20$nExp_poi

result_hc20$nExp_poi_adj
```


```{r}
###see the doublet tables 
table(
  HC20[[grep(
    "^DF.classifications_",
    colnames(HC20@meta.data),
    value = TRUE
  )[2]]]
)


HC20$doublet_classification <- HC20$DF.classifications_0.25_0.09_152
```


```{r}
library(patchwork)

df_cols <- grep(
  "^DF.classifications_",
  colnames(HC20@meta.data),
  value = TRUE
)

p1 <- DimPlot(
  HC20,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = df_cols[1],
  cols = c("Singlet" = "grey80", "Doublet" = "red")
) + ggtitle("Unadjusted doublets")

p2 <- DimPlot(
  HC20,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = df_cols[2],
  cols = c("Singlet" = "grey80", "Doublet" = "red")
) + ggtitle("Homotypic-adjusted doublets")

p1 + p2
```

```{r}
remotes::install_github("carmonalab/STACAS")

```



```{r}
library(future)
library(STACAS)
plan(sequential)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 12 * 1024^3)  # adjust to your RAM

merged_seurat <- merged_seurat %>% SplitObject(split.by = "orig.ident") %>%
      Run.STACAS(dims = 1:30, anchor.features = 2000) %>%
      RunUMAP(dims = 1:30) 

DimPlot(merged_seurat, group.by = "orig.ident", shuffle = T, alpha = 0.4)
```

### create a stacked bar plot of the different doublet levels
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Create a data frame
doublet_df <- merged_seurat@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    cluster =as.numeric(as.character(Idents(merged_seurat))),
    doublet_classification = as.factor(doublet_classification)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(doublet_df, aes(x = cluster, fill = doublet_classification)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of cells",
    fill = "Doublet classification",
    title = "Doublets per cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

doublet_df <- merged_seurat@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.numeric(as.character(Idents(merged_seurat))),
    doublet_classification = factor(doublet_classification)
  )

ggplot(doublet_df, aes(
  x = factor(cluster, levels = sort(unique(cluster))),
  fill = doublet_classification
)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Doublet" = "#F8766D", "Singlet" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Percentage of cells",
    fill = "Doublet classification",
    title = "Percentage of doublets and singlets per cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
